title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Second Jamat in Majid 3460 views Q. I will be thankful to you if you kindly define EIDGAH and enlighten me about the following: 1. Can we conduct Eid prayers in a place owned by a Muslim? 2. Can we conduct Eid prayers in a place owned by a non-Muslim? 3. Is it permissible to make a place Eidgah for one or two years where a building is to come up later on? 4. Can Eid prayers be conducted at different times in a mosque as well as in a nearby place owned by a non-Muslim with his/her permission? 2680 views Q. jume ki namaaz main sunnate muakkda kitni hai or us ki padhne ki tarteeb kya hai? 8478 views Q. Assalamualeykum Mufti Saab, We are writing to you from Kinshasa, The Democratic Republic of Congo. There are some Masail we would like to know regarding Jumma prayers. There is a big company here in Kinshasa where many of our brothers (Sunni) work, and they reside in the same compound of the company. The owner of the company is a Muslim also (Sunni), he has built a very small masjid / Ibadad khana for the brothers working in the company to pray namaz. We got to know from the brothers residing there that there is no 5 times Azaan that gets called out and no 5 times Namaaz that takes place, it only takes place sometimes. And the masjid does not totalize 40 people in prayers. The owner of the company thinks that there are 5 times prayers with azan taking place in his company, whereas there isn?t. The Owner of the company does not reside in the company compound, and he spends a lot of time out of the country. Outside the compound nearby, there is a masjid (8-10 minutes walking distance) where 5 times namaz takes place with Azaan, and Jumma prayers aswell. The question is Mufti saab, does the Masjid in the company have the right to conduct Jumma Namaz, is the Jumma namaz accepted under the above circumstances? 2153 views Q. My question is that whether women are allowed in mosque at Friday for Jumuah salah 3341 views Q. What is the minimum head count for Jumuah prayer to be valid in Hanafi & Shafi' Fiqh? 10646 views Q. Is there any specific fazeelat of last Friday of Ramadan which people usually call Alvida Jumuah? 6446 views Q. About Fasting on Arafah 8734 views Q. Establishing Friday prayer in a college campus 2601 views Q. If we are not sure whether the Friday prayer we are offering as a jamah is 2 rakah fardh or wajib 1779 views Q. What are the conditions for offering Namaz e Eid?Can Namaz e Eid be offered in a village? 2996 views Q. Can we offer Jumah in College campus? 2710 views Q. Offering Jumuah Salah in University or College 14020 views Q. Is it a sunnah to hold an aasa by imaam at the time of delivering of juma khutba? 5850 views Q. Asalamualaikum I would like to find out the ruling concerning whether istimaa' is necessary for women when listening to the juma khutbah live over the radio. It has become the norm for "Islamic" radio stations to play the juma khutbah live, sometimes for more than an hour. Generally the womenfolk are engaged in cooking and don't pay much attention to it. 1. Would the normal laws of listening to a khutbah apply here ie is it wajib? 2. Would it make a difference whether the khutba is played before zawaal or after? 3. Do menfolk also have to listen attentively? What if they have already performed juma? 4-A person who doesn't listen attentively talks while listening will he be sinful? 1917 views
answer: Prayers & Duties >> Jumuah & Eid Prayers Question ID: 10896 Country: United States of America Title: my qustion is what is the tareef of maqami when we r talking about moon sighting dose it mean ure country city state? n our imam sahab has a siecntific data from that he could see the moon if it is possible so should we follow him our we go by other citys i mean is it allow if we see amoon in any were in america so we r going to do eid or we should see it in are city jazakallah Question: my qustion is what is the tareef of maqami when we r talking about moon sighting dose it mean ure country city state? n our imam sahab has a siecntific data from that he could see the moon if it is possible so should we follow him our we go by other citys i mean is it allow if we see amoon in any were in america so we r going to do eid or we should see it in are city jazakallah Answer ID: 10896 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 297/231=H/1430) There are detailed and lengthy discussions about proof of moon-sighting which may lengthen if presented shortly as well. As far as the reply of your question is concerned, you should adhere by what is announced by the local ulama and muftis about moon. We are not aware of the scientific data and the way of its moon-sighting. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
